source.title: K-Pass surpasses 3 million users within 10 months of launch
source.publisher: Metropolitan Area Transport Commission, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport

cumulative_registered_kpass_users_count.note: The release states that users surpassed 3 million; 3,000,000 is therefore a reported threshold rather than an exact terminal count.

avg_refund_share_of_transit_spending_pct.note: Reported refund share of average monthly public-transit spending among K-Pass users.

low_income_avg_monthly_refund_per_user_k.note: Reported average among low-income K-Pass users.

prompt_leakage_policy: Ground-truth values in this file must not be included in Stage 2 simulation prompts.
